summary: Hiker Katherine Powell suffered a broken ankle ~2.5 miles above the Brainard Lake trailhead; call ~noon; Indian Peaks FPD, Nederland Fire, RMRG, AMR, Flight for Life, and BCSO responded; flown to Good Samaritan Hospital
location: Blue Lake Trail, ~2.5 mi above Brainard Lake trailhead
responding_agency: Indian Peaks Fire Protection District; Nederland Fire; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; AMR; Flight for Life; Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: During the carryout, Indian Peaks FPD / Allenspark FD EMT Dick Marchman (66) collapsed ~1 mile from the trailhead and died; obituary confirms July 9, 2014
